name: Wiilman Bilya Trail
description: A multiday walking trail around Wellington Reservoir, through yarri (blackbutt), marri and jarrah forests

name: Cape to Cape Track
description: A 123 km coastal trail along the Leeuwin-Naturaliste Ridge, between the lighthouses of Cape Naturaliste and Cape Leeuwin

name: Lake Monger
description: A 3.5 km loop around a beautiful urban wetland in Perth, with about 80,000 efforts on Strava

name: Central Park Stairs
description: A climb up the fire stairs of Perth’s tallest building, Central Park Tower – usually done in “B” stairwell from the locked door at the bottom to level 50 (level 51 has an anti base jumping alarm)

name: Attack of the Buns
description: A 3 day bike packing route through the NSW Southern Highlands and Tablelands
